title: Sakana AI’s LLM Peer Review System Catches 73% of Core-Claim Errors
notes: MarkTechPost returned HTTP 403, so no article text was read. Google News searches (four queries) returned only the MarkTechPost item for this story; no other outlet carries it. Sakana AI's own blog (sakana.ai/blog) was checked and has no matching post (latest AI Scientist posts date from March to May 2026). The entry therefore restates the headline cautiously with attribution; the 73 percent figure and the meaning of 'core-claim errors' are unverified.
